articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo doesn't understand anything: Why are Barça fans writing to her about Rodri?
articles.standfirst: The scene takes place after the midfielder's arrival at Barcelona and stems from an explanation that combines soccer, social media, and a coincidence of names.
articles.summary: The scene takes place after the midfielder's arrival at Barcelona and stems from an explanation that combines soccer, social media, and a coincidence of names.
articles.body:
The American singer unintentionally became a trending topic online after thousands of messages began appearing on one of her Instagram posts.

Barça fans took her latest post and began filling it with welcome messages. But not because of a song, her music, or her next concert, but to celebrate her arrival as the “new Barcelona player.”

The comments appeared on a post related to Smashing Pumpkins and had a very specific goal: to congratulate Rodri on his arrival at Barça . The scene drew attention for a fairly simple reason: What were the Blaugrana fans doing writing to an American pop star?

Olivia Rodrigo, an involuntary protagonist

The main response focuses on the fact that Rodri currently does not have social media. The footballer decided to stay away from Instagram, X, Snapchat , etc. Years ago he made the decision and does not have an official profile where people can leave him messages.

Given the footballer's absence from social media, some fans found an alternative as unexpected as it was funny: Olivia Rodrigo 's Instagram.

The pop star probably did not expect to receive messages from Barça fans talking about Rodri , but that was exactly what started happening on her latest Instagram post.

Although the singer already had a connection with the club, mainly because in May 2026 she was chosen by Spotify to feature on Barcelona 's jersey during El Clásico against Real Madrid . Her image replaced the platform's logo as part of the initiative that the club and Spotify carry out together with different artists. In addition, she became the youngest artist to take part in this action. However, the comments that have now appeared on her account are not related to that collaboration, but rather to the arrival of the Spanish footballer at Barça.

A situation that had already happened before

Elena G Durán was one of the people who explained through a video what was happening and, laughing, recalled that it is not the first time that the name Rodri has been involved in similar situations.

"When Rodri won the Ballon d'Or , his followers ran into the same problem: there was no official account where they could congratulate him. So, some looked for an alternative and ended up turning to Rodrigo De Paul 's Instagram.

The difference in this case is that they were not Rodri's followers, but mainly Vinícius/Real Madrid fans who were looking to confront him over the Ballon d'Or.

Why doesn't Rodri have social media?

It was the player himself who explained in an interview that he decided to stay off social media when he was still very young

“No tengo cuenta en Instagram, X, Snapchat. It was a decision I made when I was very young, although at that time it wasn’t normal at my age to have enough personality to say no”,

This is how, while the midfielder begins his new journey at Barcelona , Olivia encounters an amusing consequence: her Instagram filled with congratulations for joining the team.
